english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something happens often on different occasions.
Use this when emphasizing that something happens on many occasions rather than at every occasion.

examples.english: I often take the bus to work.
examples.traditional: 好多時我都會搭巴士返工。
examples.jyutping: hou2 do1 si4 ngo5 dou1 wui5 daap3 baa1 si6 faan1 gung1
